# Tauri Config — tauri.conf.json structure, lifecycle, CSP and platform sections

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' tauri-config: a Tauri v2 agent skill for tauri.conf.json structure, lifecycle management and CSP configuration. Trigger phrases (tauri.conf.json, config, CSP, android, ios, plus Chinese equivalents) route the agent to: identify app requirements and platform targets, map them to tauri.conf.json sections, apply the v2 config layout and plugin locations, and validate CSP and platform config for desktop and mobile. Ships with a curated reference list to the official Tauri v2 config reference and CSP docs.
